@model_validator(mode="after")
    def image_to_base64(self) -> Self:
        """Store the image as base64 and guess the mimetype when possible.

        In case the model was built passing image data but without a mimetype,
        we try to guess it using the filetype library. To avoid resource-intense
        operations, we won't load the path or the URL to guess the mimetype.
        """
        if not self.image:
            return self

        self.image = base64.b64encode(self.image)

        return self

    def get_image_mimetype(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """Get the mimetype of the image, guessing it lazily if needed.

        If no mimetype was provided when the block was created, it will be
        resolved on first access using the filetype library (or the response
        headers for URL-based images) and cached for future accesses.
        """
        if self.image_mimetype is not None:
            return self.image_mimetype

        if self.image is not None:
            guess = filetype.guess(base64.b64decode(self.image))
            self.image_mimetype = guess.mime if guess else None
        elif self.path is not None:
            guess = filetype.guess(self.path.read_bytes())
            self.image_mimetype = guess.mime if guess else None
        elif self.url is not None:
            headers = requests.head(str(self.url), allow_redirects=True).headers
            self.image_mimetype = headers.get("Content-Type")

        return self.image_mimetype

from llama_index.core.base.llms.types import ImageBlock
import struct, zlib

# PNG 1x1 red pixel
def make_png():
    sig = b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
    def chunk(typ, data):
        c = struct.pack('>I', len(data)) + typ + data
        c += struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(typ + data) & 0xffffffff)
        return c
    ihdr = chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', 1, 1, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
    idat = chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(b'\x00\xff\x00\x00'))
    iend = chunk(b'IEND', b'')
    return sig + ihdr + idat + iend

b = ImageBlock(image=make_png())
print('image set, mimetype after init:', b.image_mimetype)
print('get_image_mimetype():', b.get_image_mimetype())
print('cached now:', b.image_mimetype)

b2 = ImageBlock(image_mimetype='image/gif')
print('explicit mimetype:', b2.get_image_mimetype())
